# `{upxdvir}` Demo

## Libraries

```{r}
library("grid")
library("xdvir")
library("upxdvir")
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
options(warn = 2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = TRUE)

```

## Examples

```{r, echo = FALSE}
drawGrid <- function(border = TRUE) {
    if (border) {
        grid.rect(gp = gpar(lwd = 10, col = 2))
    }

grid.segments(
    c(0, .5),
    c(.5, 0),
    c(1, .5),
    c(.5, 1),
    gp = gpar(lty = 3, col = "gray", alpha = .5)
)
}
```

### Horizontal Typesetting

```{r, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 3, fig.width = 3}
drawGrid()
grid.latex("The text is rendered horizontally by default.", y = .7)
grid.latex("ページレイアウトのABCD設定とし")
```

### Vertical Typesetting

```{r, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 3, fig.width = 3}
drawGrid()
grid.latex(
    "The \\texttt{documentClass = 'utarticle'} parameter typesets text vertically.",
    width = unit(2.5, "in"),
    y = .8
)
grid.latex("ページABCアウトの", y = .4, documentClass = "utarticle")
```
